lemmas.primary_translation: compete with or follow someone better; not quite succeed

definitions.text: (etter den norske skihopperen Bjørn Wirkola) prøve seg mot eller følge etter en som er bedre
definitions.translation: (after the Norwegian ski jumper Bjørn Wirkola) to try one's hand against or follow someone who is better (lit. jump after Wirkola)
